name: problem-framing
description: Run a short socratic intake questioning whether the stated problem is the right one BEFORE a task exists, then write a BRIEF.md that task-init consumes. Use when an objective is fuzzy, broad, or possibly mis-scoped. Do not use for a one-sentence objective (run task-init), a bug fix or hotfix (use task-init), a decision gap (use decision-interview), or missing facts (use targeted-questions).
